Formula: P/F = PaO2 / FiO2 (FiO2 as a decimal, e.g. 40% = 0.4); OI = (MAP x FiO2 x 100) / PaO2; OI >40 suggests severe respiratory failure.
map.⚠️ P/F 受 PEEP、海拔、血红蛋白影响；SpO2-based 估算 P/: P/F is affected by PEEP, altitude and hemoglobin; SpO2-based P/F estimation is less accurate at high SpO2, so arterial blood gas is preferred.
